e1.note: Text requires loans be 'fully colla teralized' but does not state the 100 percent collateral threshold.

e2.quote: A loan must allow for termination at any time

e3.note: Text allows cash invested under the Investment Act generally rather than limiting it to Sections 2256.009, .013, .014, or .016.

e4.note: Text does not state that collateral must be deposited with the entity or an approved third party.

e5.quote: A loan must be placed through a primary government securities dealer or a financial institution doing business in Texas. A loan must allow for termination at any time and must have a term of one year or less.
